en.title: Minimum Sum of Weekly Maximums When Splitting Activities in Order
en.description:
Split all activities, in their original order, into exactly weeks non-empty contiguous groups, each scheduled in its own week; the effort of a week equals the maximum effort of the activities in its group. Find the minimum total effort over all weeks.

The standard I/O, examples and editorial were written independently by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n weeks and the second line contains the effort array. The original bounds are 1≤n≤300, 1≤weeks≤n, 1≤cost[i]≤100000.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
en.explanation: The answers are 9500, 6 and 5. The number of weeks must be exactly as given; no week can be empty, and activities cannot be reordered.
hints: dp[w][i] is the minimum total effort for splitting the first i activities into w weeks. Enumerate the start j of the last week and transition with dp[w−1][j]+max(cost[j:i]). Maintain the range maximum while enumerating j leftward, and roll over the week layers.
